title: Expanded Campfires
description: Expanded Campfire Cooking Recipes and Block/Item Displays
body:
Ads a few unique recipes to campfires such as:
Rotten Flesh -> Leather
Chorus Fruit -> Popped Chorus Fruit
Red Terracotta -> Red Glazed Terracotta
and many more, mess around and see what all you can find.

Additionally ads Campfire displays for all other items/blocks
*unlit campfire items stay forever
*lit campfire items pop off after 1 billion ticks
